claim: Produces a User Research Protocol and Findings with a session ledger, supporting and disconfirming observations, coverage limits, confidence, and non-claims a decision owner can act on.

baseline.prompt: We interviewed 6 users of our habit-tracking app about why they stop using it after two weeks. Write research-findings.md with what we learned, how confident we are, and what we should not claim.
